_comment: Oslo S (NSR, Bane NOR). First draft 2026-10-28 from OSM via Overpass. The train platforms are multipolygon relations in OSM (refs 1;2 … 19), so multipolygons is on. OSM tags the station's walkways with levels -1, 0, 1 and 2; the levels are named by number until the owner's video and Bane NOR's plan say what each is called. Bus platforms (Oslo bussterminal, bus=yes) and the T-bane platforms (subway=yes, layer -2) are left out by the drafter's filters.

changelog.what: First draft from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, 2026-10-28), schema 2. Levels named by number only; the video and Bane NOR's plan are still to be read.
